Case_13009/figure1.jpg.source_caption: Radiograph of the right knee with effusion.

description.short_caption: Lateral radiograph of the right knee showing effusion.
description.detailed_description: This is a lateral radiograph of the right knee. The image demonstrates a soft tissue density in the suprapatellar region, consistent with joint effusion. The bony structures, including the femur, tibia, and patella, appear intact without evidence of fracture or dislocation. The joint space is preserved, and no obvious lytic or sclerotic lesions are visible.
visible_findings: soft tissue density in suprapatellar region

Case_13009/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Culture plate of growth in anaerobic bottle of joint fluid.

description.short_caption: Culture plate showing growth from anaerobic bottle of joint fluid.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a culture plate with visible growth streaks on the surface of the agar. The plate appears to have been inoculated with material from an anaerobic bottle, likely joint fluid. The growth is subtle and evenly distributed, suggesting a bacterial culture. The lighting highlights the texture and streaking pattern, which is consistent with microbial growth.
visible_findings: even distribution of growth on the plate

Case_13009/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Culture growth from anaerobic bottle of joint fluid (4x magnification).

description.short_caption: Culture growth from anaerobic bottle of joint fluid at 4x magnification.
description.detailed_description: The image shows a culture plate with visible growth under 4x magnification. The background is a uniform yellowish hue, and circular structures of varying sizes are scattered throughout the field. These structures appear to be colonies or microbial growth, consistent with culture from an anaerobic environment. The uniformity of the background and the distinct circular colonies suggest a controlled culture environment.

Case_13009/figure4.jpg.source_caption: Colonies of Mycoplasma species (10x magnification) on ureaplasma differential agar (A7).

description.short_caption: Colonies of Mycoplasma species on ureaplasma differential agar (A7).
description.detailed_description: This image shows a culture plate with multiple small, circular colonies of Mycoplasma species on ureaplasma differential agar (A7). The colonies exhibit a characteristic 'fried egg' appearance, with a dense central zone and a lighter peripheral zone. The background agar is smooth and uniform, with visible streak lines from inoculation. The image is taken at 10x magnification, highlighting the colony morphology.
visible_findings: Small, circular colonies with 'fried egg' morphology.
Smooth agar background with streak lines.
